newsitem.title: INDIA: Ingersoll-Rand wins $40 mln deal with Indian ONGC.
newsitem.headline: Ingersoll-Rand wins $40 mln deal with Indian ONGC.

text.p: The U.S.-based Ingersoll-Rand Company said on Saturday it had won a $40 million contract with India's Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) to supply air compressors in an oil recovery project.
A company statement in New Delhi said, under the contract, Ingersoll-Rand would supply some other related infrastructural facilities to ONGC's project at Santhal in the western state of Gujarat.

"The Santhal facility, which will enhance oil recovery in India and maximize the use of the nation's natural resources, is being financed by the ONGC...The facility is scheduled to be completed by 2000," it said.

The statement quoted Rick Johannessen, president of Ingersoll-Rand (India) Limited as saying: "Not only is it the single largest order ever received by Ingersoll-Rand (India) Limited, but it was awarded to us against stiff global competition."
